product.promise: Thirty seconds of threading a glowing dot through gaps, where every death is one you saw coming and the next run is one touch away
product.audience: Someone filling a short wait on their phone, one thumb free, who will also open it on a laptop
product.context: Standing on a platform or in a queue, portrait, sound usually off, attention split; a run has to make sense at a glance and survive being interrupted

keeps: The one-button rule: hold to rise, release to fall, nothing else to learn
The look: the #20163a night, mint walls, amber dot, white sparks; no new art
The saved best score in localStorage under blip.highScore, read and written exactly as before
Scoring: 1 per wall, 3 for a near miss

pillars: You always see what will kill you
Flying close is the brave, paid choice
Dead to flying again in under a second

loop.verb: hold and release to float the dot through the next gap
loop.challenge: gaps that arrive faster, sit further apart vertically and start to drift
loop.feedback: a rising tick and a +1 at the dot for each wall; a brighter chime, CLOSE +3 and a burst when you skim an edge
loop.reward: score, a streak that raises the pitch of each tick, and a saved best that flashes when beaten

controls.desktop: Space or Up held to rise; Escape or P to pause; M to mute
controls.touch: hold anywhere on the play field to rise; 44 px pause and mute buttons in the top corners, inside the safe area

feedback.response: the hint fades, the dot lifts, the music starts under it
tick that climbs a semitone per wall in the streak, +1 rises from the dot
chime, CLOSE +3 in amber, sixteen sparks, the wall edge flashes white

feedback.event: drifting toward the top or bottom edge
feedback.response: that edge glows red, brighter the closer the dot gets
110 ms freeze, shake, the dot bursts, an explosion, and the wall or edge that did it stays lit red
the score turns amber, a rising chime, NEW BEST over the retry prompt
everything stops, the field dims, PAUSED with how to resume

curve.introduces: a ready screen: the dot hovers until the first hold, then wide 190 px gaps near the middle
gaps anywhere on the field, always reachable from the last one at the current speed
gaps narrow toward 150 px while speed climbs to its cap
gaps that drift slowly up and down as they approach

play.fail: Only a wall or a lit edge kills, the hitbox is 4 px kinder than the drawing, no gap is ever out of reach, and what killed you stays red during the freeze. Retry is one press after a 350 ms lock so a held thumb does not skip the result.
play.mastery: Hugs the edge of every gap on purpose for +3, feathering the hold in short taps to hover instead of swinging
playtest: After your first three deaths, could you say what killed you each time?
Did you go for a near miss on purpose at least once?
Did you start another run without thinking about it?
With the sound off on a phone, did you still know when you scored?

done_when: A new player is flying within three seconds of the page loading and is never killed before their first input
Every death shows its cause in red for the length of the freeze
Escape, P, the pause button and switching tabs all stop the game, and it resumes exactly where it was
A best score saved by the old version is still shown as the best
